This benchmark just suffocated the models with constrictive scaffolding.

🚨 Shocking: Frontier LLMs score 85-95% on standard coding benchmarks. We gave them equivalent problems in languages they couldn't have memorized. They collapsed to 0-11%.

First test, I asked it to illustrate two jumping spiders that I know well, which are barely documented online. Mistakes include replicating the Wikipedia photo of T.h. well but labeling it T.m., and T.m. not being replicated well, likely due to a lack of good pictures in search.
